Weekly rankings

Half-PPR projections if active, with realistic ranges. Tap a player for his full card.

How to read
Projection assumes the player is active (NFL availability is yes/no, so injured players show an Inactive% instead of a discount). Tap a player for his range of outcomes. # is our rank; the number in parentheses is the FantasyPros expert consensus rank ("lw" = last week's, until Friday). Last 5: his last five games this season; green = beat our projection for that game, red = missed it, the white tick is the projection. Matchup: the opponent's defense vs the position, 1st = toughest to 32nd = easiest. TD ring: chance of at least one touchdown (hover for 1 / 2 / 3+). A yellow edge marks a projection boosted by a teammate's absence.
Preset
Points per stat
League (sets the tiers)

Projections are stat lines, so any scoring re-scores them exactly. Blended-in expert ranks and the floor/ceiling ranges are scaled by the same ratio (an approximation). Saved on this device.

Power rankings

Opponent-adjusted points per game vs an average team. Everything adds up: Offense = Pass O + Run O, Defense = Pass D + Run D, Net = Offense + Defense + ST.

How to read
Every number is points per game against an average opponent: each unit's per-play rating times a league-average number of those plays (about 36 dropbacks, 25 runs and 12 special-teams plays), so the columns add up and a run edge is never read as equal to a pass edge. Hover any unit for its per-play rating. Pass O includes the team's current starting quarterback. Higher is better everywhere, including defense. Rank range is the 10th-90th percentile rank when ratings are resampled within their uncertainty (200 bootstrap resamples of games): a narrow range means the data has settled, a wide one means a few more games could move the team a lot. Colored badges are league ranks (green = top 8, red = bottom 8). Schedule: points per game the opponents took away (played) or would take away (left), unit by unit: the team's actual dropbacks against each opponent's pass defense and runs against its run defense, plus the offenses its defense faced. Positive = tougher than average; 1st = hardest. Re-scored every week with current ratings. Arrows show the move since last week.
